description: This file implements the core logic for a DoorBell class, including network socket management, binding, unbinding, and event handling for a doorbell notification system within the WPEFramework. It defines the Connector nested class responsible for socket operations and the DoorBell class constructor and destructor.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles socket creation, binding, unbinding, and event management for the DoorBell system.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents the DoorBell object managing network connections and signaling.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::~Connector
methods.description: Destructor that closes sockets and cleans up resources.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the socket, sets socket options, and registers for events.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Unbind
methods.description: Unregisters the socket from event monitoring.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the socket handle for event monitoring.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Events
methods.description: Returns the events to monitor on the socket.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events, such as read readiness.

methods.name: DoorBell::DoorBell
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DoorBell with a source name.
